title: Default Models Registry
description: `crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/default_models.json`, embedded at compile time via `include_str!` and parsed at runtime [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/lib.rs:9-12,31-33]. Rust (`DefaultModels`/`DefaultModelEntry`) only reads `default`, `web_search`, `image_description`, `session_summary`, and `models[].model` [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/lib.rs:14-29] — every other property below is part of the full on-disk key set (verified against the real file) that Rust ignores as forward-compatible unknown data, presumably consumed elsewhere (UI/model-picker code) rather than by this loader. A runtime assertion (not expressible in this schema) requires `default` to equal one of `models[].model` [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/lib.rs:36-41]; enforce that invariant in the validation harness, not via JSON Schema alone. Model resolution order at runtime: CLI flag > ENV var > config.toml > remote settings > these defaults [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/lib.rs:4-6].

default.description: Primary model id for coding tasks and general fallback. Required field on `DefaultModels`; must equal one of `models[].model` (enforced by a runtime `assert!`, not by Deserialize). [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/lib.rs:14,16,36-41,47-49]

web_search.description: Model id for web search tool synthesis. `Option<String>`; falls back to `default` when absent. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/lib.rs:18-19,52-54]

image_description.description: Model id for image description. `Option<String>`; falls back to `default` when absent. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/lib.rs:20-21,57-62]

session_summary.description: Model id for session title generation. `Option<String>`; falls back to `default` when absent. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/lib.rs:22-23,65-70]

models.description: Model catalog. Required field on `DefaultModels` (`Vec<DefaultModelEntry>`); Rust itself only deserializes each item's `model` field, the rest is documented from the real on-disk file. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/lib.rs:23,26-29]

modelEntry.description: Single model catalog entry. Only `model` is required by `DefaultModelEntry`; every other property is the full on-disk key set observed in the real `default_models.json`, not enforced by this Rust loader. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/lib.rs:26-29]

id.description: Stable catalog identifier for this model entry. On-disk-only field, not read by `DefaultModelEntry`. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/default_models.json]

model.description: Model id string used for resolution/matching against `default`/`web_search`/`image_description`/`session_summary`. Required field on `DefaultModelEntry`. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-models/src/lib.rs:28,36-41]
